_note: 2v2: blows, shots and beams that reach a body of the other fight (docs/architecture/cross-fights.md; sim/core/cross.gd). Read only by a match of two fights (a setup's "fights": 2). Teams by starting slot: 0 and 2 against 1 and 3. First values.
_enabled: a setup's "cross" overrides it for a match. Off, nothing reaches the other fight and nothing is hashed

beam._note: A beam's hit on an enemy of the other fight in its width, once a beam: SimDamage.hit's damage by his stance, the hold in seconds and the shake. The damage is a clean signature hit's (DirBeam's 230)

_rejoinAfter: seconds of a fight's KO before its winner and the other fight's, one on each team, are made one fight's pair (2v2's step 3). Its slow motion is 2.2
